title: Design Audit Report
description: Structured output of running design-audit-rubric.md against a design. Drives the pipeline's approve/revise routing.

autoReviseAttempt.description: 0 = first audit of this design. Increments each time a major-issues verdict triggers an automatic revise-and-reaudit loop, per automation.maxAutoReviseAttempts.

escalatedFromMajorIssues.description: True when this report's overallVerdict is 'blocker' only because maxAutoReviseAttempts was exhausted on repeated major-issues verdicts — distinguishes 'genuinely blocked' from 'agent gave up self-correcting' for the human reviewing it.

overallAssessment.description: 1-2 sentences on the current state of the design, for the presentation template's 'Overall Assessment' line. Also where decision-protocol-compliance findings surface, since that category is excluded from the phased sections (see audit-presentation-template.md).

designSystemUpdatesRequired.description: Populates the template's 'DESIGN_SYSTEM UPDATES REQUIRED' section. Auto-derived from gap reports linked to reuse-and-component-discipline findings, plus any token-and-scale-consistency finding that needs a genuinely new token.

description.description: e.g. 'New token: spacing-lg (20px) for StatTile gap, not currently in spacing.scale.'

rubricItem.description: Short quote/id of the rubric checklist item that was violated.

description.description: What was found, specific to this design.

location.description: Where in the design this occurs, e.g. component name, screen, section.

manifestReference.description: The manifest field this check was evaluated against, e.g. 'accessibility.minTouchTargetPx'.

relatedGapReportId.description: For reuse-discipline findings, the gap report this should have referenced.

presentationPhase.description: Which phase this renders under in audit-presentation-template.md. Defaults per the category→phase mapping table in that file; set explicitly here to override (e.g. a category-1 accessibility issue that's cosmetic enough to defer to Phase 2 in a specific case).

implementationNote.description: Required to populate 'IMPLEMENTATION NOTES FOR BUILD AGENT'. A finding can exist without this (e.g. still being diagnosed), but cannot be rendered into that section until populated — no vague instructions allowed through.

additionalContext.description: Optional supporting fact, e.g. a contrast ratio improvement — only include when it strengthens the instruction, per the WCAG contrast example.
